verdict.rationale: Wise publishes an extensive public API reference covering business payments from a Wise account, multi-currency balances and statements, batch transfers, cards, spend controls, disputes and support cases, plus webhook subscriptions. An llms.txt at docs.wise.com makes the docs easier for AI agents to consume. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Wise Business via the API.
